cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(DoxTkConsumer LANGUAGES CXX)
option(DOXTK_CONSUMER_CPPDSL "Test the installed optional CPPDSL component" OFF)
if(DOXTK_CONSUMER_CPPDSL)
  find_package(DoxTk 0.1 CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS CPPDSL)
else()
  find_package(DoxTk 0.1 CONFIG REQUIRED)
endif()
add_executable(consumer main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(consumer PRIVATE DoxTk::DoxTk)
if(DOXTK_CONSUMER_CPPDSL)
  target_link_libraries(consumer PRIVATE DoxTk::CPPDSL)
endif()
